name: invocation-ritual
description: Debug Wizard climbs from the Sanctum to the invocation level, finds the vibrating square, wishes for and prepares the Bell, Candelabrum, candles, and Book of the Dead, then performs the complete ritual. The trace covers relic timing and discovery, six terrain-animation rings, fire traps, new moats, monster drowning and corpse creation, experience gain, and the new stair to the Sanctum.
